n, m, Mod = map(int, input().split())

MAX_SIZE = 577

# Initialize combination array C
C = [[0] * MAX_SIZE for _ in range(MAX_SIZE)]
for i in range(MAX_SIZE):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
for i in range(1, MAX_SIZE):
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[j][i] = (C[j][i - 1] + C[j - 1][i - 1]) % Mod

def getSum(a, b):
    return ((a + b) * (b - a + 1) // 2) % Mod

dp = [0] * (n + 1)
dp2 = [0] * (n + 1)
dp[0] = 1
dp2[0] = 0

for length in range(1, n + 1):
    for i in range(1, length + 1):
        sum_val = getSum(1, i - 1) + getSum(1, length - i)
        count = length + 1
        val_dp = (dp[i - 1] * count % Mod) * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod
        val_dp2 = (sum_val * dp[i - 1] % Mod) * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod
        val_dp2_alt = (dp2[i - 1] * count % Mod) * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod
        val_dp2_other = (dp2[length - i] * count % Mod) * dp[i - 1] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod

        if length == 1:
            dp[length] = 0
            dp2[length] = 0
        else:
            if 'dp[length]' not in locals():
                dp[length] = 0
            if 'dp2[length]' not in locals():
                dp2[length] = 0
            dp[length] = (dp[length] + val_dp) % Mod
            dp2[length] = (dp2[length] + val_dp2 + val_dp2_alt + val_dp2_other) % Mod

res = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
res2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        res[i][j] = res[i - 1][j]
        res2[i][j] = res2[i - 1][j]
        for h in range(1, j):
            res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res2[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp2[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
        res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + dp[j]) % Mod
        res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + dp2[j]) % Mod

print(res2[n][m])
